normalization.paths: repository-relative; scratch paths and tokens omitted
normalization.durations: monotonic milliseconds rounded to three decimals
normalization.distributions: nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 over measured runs after warmups
normalization.residue: PIDs are retained only to prove the exact observed process set is dead; no environment or daemon output text is retained

bundleFreshness.method: esbuild API with exact package.json bundle-command policy assertion
